frontMatter.title: Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ Team Finish Runners-Up in League Final
frontMatter.summary: Our Grade 2 Mixed ‘A’ team—Alo, Elaine, Anneke and Gerard—finished as runners-up in last night’s league final in Wilkinstown after a strong season, with a standout performance from Elaine Maher serving 21 consecutive points.

prev.title: National Napping Day… but Monday Club Night won’t wait!
prev.summary: National Napping Day or not, Monday Club Night is on at Claremont: Grade 2 Ladies Navan ‘B’ vs Navan ‘A’, two courts available from 8:30pm, and Juveniles at 6:30pm (Girls) and 7:30pm (Boys).

next.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont: Navan vs Loughegar & Navan vs Ardee + Social Badminton
next.summary: Thursday Club Night is on at Claremont with Grade 4 Mens (Navan vs Loughegar) and Grade 7 Ladies (Navan vs Ardee), followed by two courts of social badminton from 9:30pm.
